name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 54 - Am 136
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 54 a. Recognises that some Members States have already spent billions of euro on protecting the Union's external borders, which, in the case of Hungary, amounts to EUR 2 billion, requests these costs to be compensated; regrets that while Hungary protects the Union's external border against illegal migration, the European Court of Justice imposed a fine on the country for not letting migrants enter Hungary before a final decision is made on their application;
